governance.title: Governance on this surface
points: Configuration, connectivity and delivery are different truth states.
Secrets are never shown; only the approved contract and runtime state are shown.
Providers that are not available are stopped safely. Features that need them show this limit.
governance.note: We do not copy names, update times or health labels from the test system. This page only shows what you may see. If a record is missing, you see 'Not available' or an empty list.
